title: Blend your own fragrance in New Orleans
description: At Tijon’s fragrance lab, begin by smelling individual notes and noticing which ones you return to. Mix a formula in a beaker, adjust it, and compare variations until it feels like yours. A guided class turns the usually mysterious process of perfume-making into a series of small, personal decisions you can actually smell.
teaser: Build a scent one note and adjustment at a time.
goodToKnow: A gentle sensory workshop. Check reservations and any fragrance sensitivities before attending.
whyItMightDelightYou: A familiar smell can hold a place or a moment long after the trip ends.
